hypotheses.statement: Yellow taxi trips on Thursday 2024-11-28 were lower than the average of the three prior Thursdays in November 2024.
hypotheses.support_if: Trips on 2024-11-28 < average trips on 2024-11-07, 2024-11-14, 2024-11-21 by a meaningful margin (e.g., >10%).
hypotheses.refute_if: Trips on 2024-11-28 are within normal variance of the prior Thursday baseline.

hypotheses.statement: Thanksgiving Day (2024-11-28) is a federal holiday that suppresses commuter and tourist demand, causing the drop.
hypotheses.support_if: us_holidays confirms 2024-11-28 is a national holiday (Thanksgiving) and baseline Thursdays are not holidays.
hypotheses.refute_if: 2024-11-28 is not marked as a holiday, or baseline Thursdays also have holidays.

hypotheses.statement: Adverse weather (precipitation, snow, or extreme cold) on 2024-11-28 reduced trip demand relative to baseline Thursdays.
hypotheses.support_if: nyc_weather_daily shows significant prcp_mm, snow_mm, or low tmax_c on 2024-11-28 vs. baseline Thursdays.
hypotheses.refute_if: Weather on 2024-11-28 is similar to or better than baseline Thursdays.

hypotheses.statement: The mix of trip distances or fares shifted on 2024-11-28 (e.g., fewer short trips, more long trips), indicating a demand composition change rather than pure volume drop.
hypotheses.support_if: avg_trip_distance or avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 differs materially from baseline Thursdays.
hypotheses.refute_if: avg_trip_distance and avg_total_amount on 2024-11-28 are statistically similar to baseline.

hypotheses.statement: The apparent drop is due to missing or incomplete trip data for 2024-11-28 in the source system.
hypotheses.support_if: Trip count on 2024-11-28 is implausibly low (e.g., near zero) or daily row is missing; d_holiday in date_dim disagrees with us_holidays.
hypotheses.refute_if: Data for 2024-11-28 exists and appears complete; no data-quality flags.

answer.headline: Yellow taxi trips plummeted 45.5% on Thanksgiving 2024, driven by holiday demand collapse.
answer.answer: Yellow taxi trips on Thursday 28 November 2024 fell to 77,244, a 45.5% drop versus the average of the three prior Thursdays in November (141,603). The primary driver is Thanksgiving Day, a federal holiday that suppresses both commuter and tourist travel. Data for 2024-11-28 is complete with no quality flags; weather conditions were mild and did not contribute to the decline.
answer.recommendation: Attribute the drop to Thanksgiving Day; no operational adjustments are needed for holiday periods. Monitor post-holiday recovery trends. Ensure holiday calendars are correctly loaded in future analytical pipelines to avoid misclassification.

lessons: Use us_holidays table, not TPCDS date_dim.d_holiday, for national holiday classification (d_holiday flag is unreliable for major holidays).
Always compare against same-weekday baselines when evaluating holiday effects; weekday composition matters.
Check precipitation across all baseline days; a single-day outlier does not indicate a weather trend.
